summary: S4 implemented: semantic resolution and paint-order stacking; final VM gates green.
body:
Changed files:

- [resolve.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/resolve/crates/interchange/src/scene/resolve.rs): resolver and public output types.
- [resolve/tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/resolve/crates/interchange/src/scene/resolve/tests.rs): 20 tests with inline, hand-worked fixtures.
- [stack.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/resolve/crates/interchange/src/scene/stack.rs): assignment and three tests, including proptest and 100,000-item cases.
- [mod.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/resolve/crates/interchange/src/scene/mod.rs): only two `pub mod` declarations.

Public API:

```rust
resolve::resolve(doc: &SceneDoc<'_>, limits: &ResolveLimits) -> Result<Resolved>
Resolved::node(&self, index: usize) -> Option<&ResolvedNode>
Resolved::key_time(&self, node: usize, time_base: TimeBase, t: f64) -> Option<f64>
stack::assign(items: &[Span]) -> Vec<u32>
```

`Resolved` contains project settings, nodes in paint order, transitions, unmappable subtree roots, and structured notes. Nodes expose XML handles, stable indices, containment and transform parents, clocks, intervals, source maps, layout matrices, opacity, animations with resolved key times, unsupported features, and XSD-defaulted attributes.

Integration details:

- Stable indices are document preorder, **not positions in `nodes`**. Use `Resolved::node(index)` for references.
- `interval` is nominal visibility; `span` includes transition handles and ancestor clipping. Source segments cover `span`. Convert resolved seconds to Tick in the importer, then pass spans to stacking.
- `SourceMap::Remap` retains composition-time keys, interpolation, and optional `freeze_local`; it does not add clipIn.
- `unmappable` identifies each unsupported subtree root once. Per-node `unsupported` flags preserve unsupported behavior within otherwise mappable nodes. Advanced layouts, constraints, and effects remain flagged for reporting.
- Stack assignment uses O(n log n) time and O(n) storage. Empty or reversed spans occupy nothing on track 0. The documented u32 index ceiling saturates for more than 2³² overlapping items.

Design decisions and ambiguities:

- Group clocks preserve the group start as origin: `child = origin + (parent - origin - offset) * scale`, following `sr-eval/src/eval.rs::clock_time` and `program.rs::group_clock`.
- Absent ends inherit the parent unless finite media metadata/clipOut supplies an intrinsic duration, following `program.rs::layer_clock`. Frozen and remapped layers retain inherited windows. Declared asset duration is usable without probing; missing duration is inferred from clipOut or the interval and reported.
- An explicit end can continue an **unlooped** source clock past clipOut; repeated playback holds after its final play. This follows `program.rs::MediaClock::map`; the resolver reports the extension.
- Relative anchors use the parent box; pixel anchors on fitted layers use fit-box coordinates. This follows XSD `transformAttributes` and sr-core `CONVENTIONS.md` §1.2.
- Static explicit `parent` references replace containment transforms; opacity still follows containment. This follows `eval.rs::visit/world_of`.
- An outgoing node with an inherited end uses the incoming start as the transition cut. Handles propagate through inheriting children and remain clipped by ancestor visibility. See XSD `transitionType` and `program.rs::transitions`.
- Schematron C15 rejects playback controls alongside timeRemap, despite the XSD specifying precedence. Required fixtures validate without errors; an additional defensive fixture explicitly verifies C15, then checks remap precedence without evaluating ignored rate arithmetic or expanding loops.

Provenance: no verbatim source was copied. Timing, sequence placement, transitions, and transform-parent semantics were adapted from `/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-eval/src/program.rs` and `eval.rs`. `layout.rs` was consulted for fit-box semantics. Reference checkout revision: `9ebe0889b946aea2bbb8156c1fa0bfbd2b405b84`. Integrator should record these paths in ATTRIBUTION.md; that file was outside my scope.

TDD log—all runs used the VM wrapper:

- `scene_stack_paint_order_and_handles`: `[0,0,0]` versus `[0,1,2]`; `scene_stack_properties`: overlapping-pair ordering assertion failed; `scene_stack_100k_bounded`: `Some(0)` versus `Some(99999)`. All three subsequently passed.
- Initial resolver tests, prefixed `scene_resolve_`: `source_spans_rates_and_holds`, `remap_supersedes_playback`, `group_clock_inheritance_and_key_bases`, `sequence_markers_and_defaults`, `layout_units_anchor_parent_matrix_and_z`, `transitions_and_extended_spans`, and `unmappable_roots_and_animated_parent` failed against stubs with missing results/nodes or zero transition/subtree counts. All passed after implementation.
- `hostile_loop_cap`, `hostile_parent_cycle`, `hostile_depth`, `hostile_overflow`, and `hostile_nonfinite` each failed their `is_err()` assertion against a successful stub, then passed with defensive checks.
- `inherited_end_transition_uses_incoming_start`: cut 30 versus 5; `transition_source_handles`: end 5 versus 6; `rate_underflow_is_error`: `is_err()` failed; `transition_handles_respect_container_window`: start 1 versus 2. All passed after fixes.
- `explicit_end_keeps_unlooped_source_clock_running`: source 4 versus 7; `remap_ignores_rate_arithmetic_and_loop_budget`: unexpected non-finite computation error. Both passed after fixes.
- `static_parent_reference_overrides_containment_transform`: missing world matrix; `group_transition_handles_reach_inheriting_children`: child end 5 versus 6. Both passed after fixes.

Final required command completed successfully: clippy with `-D warnings`; **87 unit + 59 integration tests = 146 passed**, including all **23 new tests**; wasm check passed for **50 crates**. Local rustfmt and `git diff --check` also passed. No local builds/tests, dependency changes, commits, or pushes.
